changelog: A SECOND DESKTOP PASS. Achievements had lost its top rail and corners once the panel was widened — the frame is closed again. Settings reads as a two-column command panel and the sound dial is the size it was drawn to be. Generals unlocks no longer stretch across the frame. The map's top bar sits on real plates instead of flat chips and the legend grows to fill the column. TILE INSPECT FINALLY NAMES WHAT IS ON THE TILE: a command node used to read as "Plain" and never said who held it — it now shows the flag, held by you (+1 max CP), held by the enemy, or unheld. Node view, card view and tile inspect are all roughly doubled; toasts sit under the top bar instead of mid-screen; the battle scrollbars are gone; and FULLSCREEN is on by default with a proper toggle in Settings. PLAY: CURSES TELL YOU NOW — stepping on a mine or springing a crate trap added a curse to your deck in total silence, because those two routes skipped the code that announces it, and they never unlocked in your collection either. OVERCLOCK+ holds at 2 CP and QUADRUPLES actions and move instead of doubling. THE ENEMY TURN IS 50% SLOWER — it had been compressed too far to read; tap to skip. NO ROUTE can hand out more than three camps. RIGHT-CLICK A CARD TO STAR IT — at your keep limit the oldest star moves to the card you picked. CARD UPGRADES AND REMOVALS now wait for you and show up wherever they happen, whether that is an event, a shop or a mid-battle workshop; they used to vanish after 2.8 seconds and only ever appeared on the map screen. FIXED: THE DESKTOP UPDATER. Its Download button did nothing when pressed. This build must be installed manually once; after that the in-app updater works.
